- Where a test needs Kristin to have read the card as setup, first put the protagonist with the laptop in the way the other tests already do for reach (look at how existing tests handle `reach_entity_ids` claims such as the michelle_phone and michelle_drawer ones, and at tests/test_1a_research_files_eligibility.py), then read the card.
